test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under the 'Karmayogi Bharat' project, ____________ are given online training for better performance in services through digital means.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Public servants**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Under the** 'Karmayogi Bharat' project,** **Public servants **are given online training for better performance in services through digital means.
 
• **The Karmayogi Bharat project **offers online training for **civil service officials **through the iGOT Karmayogi platform, which is a component of the **National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building (NPCSCB).**
 
• This digital learning platform, known as iGOT Karmayogi, facilitates learning anytime, anywhere, and on any device.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• It functions as a comprehensive solution space, integrating five functional hubs for** online learning.**
 
• The platform is meticulously crafted to support customized competency development for all civil service officials.
 
• Karmayogi Bharat (SPV) is a wholly government-owned, not-for-profit company established under Section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013.
